children: has made an additional $20M strategic investment in XTEND AI Robotics
, a physical AI and robotics company that is also an existing UMAC customer.

The latest investment brings Unusual Machines’ total investment in XTEND to $27.5M and is part of, and not in addition to, the $110M financing, which closed in connection with XTEND's business combination and NYSE listing.
"We believe drones are part of a much bigger shift toward autonomous systems and robotics,"

Allan Evans, chief executive officer of Unusual Machines. "When we look at strategic investments, we look for companies that are expanding what unmanned systems can do, demonstrating an ability to execute, and investing in the U.S. industrial base. XTEND is doing all three very well. We believe they have an important role to play in where the industry is headed."
XTND shares rose 2.5% in premarket trading.
